name: gh-flow
description: Carry a GitHub issue all the way to a reviewed PR in one run. Five skills: the ordinary path from an issue number; autopilot, from an approved spec; a backlog drain that finishes only when every deferred item has become an issue of its own; dependency waves that run a set of issues in parallel worktrees with a live-verify barrier between waves; and a single-issue wave that merges one issue and then only its marked descendants, verified from a fresh clone.
